title: 친구 집에서 나올 때: 이제 가야 돼요
objective: Say goodbye correctly and give a reason for leaving with -아야/어야 돼요.
summary: Learn how to leave a friend's home politely.
setting: Mark is at his Korean friend Jisu's home for dinner. It is 9 p.m., and he is getting ready to leave.

task.title: Choose, complete, and answer
task.line: Use the dialogue and the expressions above to answer each question.

words.meaning: goodbye — said TO the person who is leaving
words.exampleMeaning: (a shop clerk to a customer) Thank you. Goodbye.

words.meaning: goodbye — said BY the person leaving, to someone who stays
words.exampleMeaning: (leaving a restaurant) Thank you for the meal. Goodbye.

words.meaning: have to go (verb stem + -아야/어야 돼요; 하다 → 해야 돼요)
words.exampleMeaning: I have to get to work by nine.

words.meaning: now (it's time to do something new)
words.exampleMeaning: Class is over. Now let's have lunch.

words.meaning: get home safely (take care on the way)
go on back inside — said to someone seeing you off at the door
words.exampleMeaning: It's cold, teacher. Please go back inside.

dialogue.korean: 지수 씨, 저 이제 가야 돼요.
dialogue.meaning: Jisu, I have to go now.

dialogue.korean: 네, 내일 아침에 일찍 일어나야 돼요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I have to get up early tomorrow morning.
Oh, I see. Then get home safely.
Okay, let's meet again. Go on back inside.
Okay, goodbye. (to Mark, who is leaving)

exercises: Choose the right goodbye (안녕히 가세요 / 안녕히 계세요): ① You are leaving a café. The owner stays. ② Your friend is leaving your house. You stay.
Fill in the blank with -아야/어야/해야 돼요: ① 내일 시험이 있어요. 오늘 ____. (공부하다) ② 10시 버스를 ____. (타다) ③ 감기에 걸렸어요. 약을 ____. (먹다)
Put the words in the right order: 집에 / 돼요 / 일찍 / 가야 / 오늘은
Read the dialogue and answer in Korean: 마크 씨는 왜 집에 가야 돼요?
answers: ① 안녕히 계세요 ② 안녕히 가세요
① 공부해야 돼요 (공부해야 해요) ② 타야 돼요 (타야 해요) ③ 먹어야 돼요 (먹어야 해요)
오늘은 일찍 집에 가야 돼요. (오늘은 집에 일찍 가야 돼요.)
